Maria and Iwa Moto are unbothered by people who find their blended family setup strange, saying what matters most is that their family gets along and makes the arrangement work. The actresses faced the media on Monday, Nov. 24, to talk about their friendship and parenting styles as their blended family graced the 2026 holiday cover of Smart Parenting magazine. Sta. Maria was previously married to Pampi Lacson, with whom she shares a son, Thirdy. Their marriage was annulled in 2024, even as they continue to co-parent their child.
